source_name: 景気動向指数 採用系列
selection_policy: DemandScope default samples must have a defensible consumption/demand interpretation. Sector-specific or ambiguous macro variables remain disabled until product-specific evidence justifies them.

variables.research_reference: Abe (2012), Journal of Household Economics 36, 59-72; Cabinet Office Consumer Confidence Survey methodology
variables.selection_reason: Japan evidence finds consumer confidence influences consumption expenditure even controlling for disposable income; the official survey is designed to capture prospects relevant to consumption and durable-goods purchasing.

variables.research_reference: Jinnai et al. (2021/2023 publication page), Household Inflation Expectation and Consumption: Evidence from Japan
variables.exclusion_reason: Inflation/consumption effects are context dependent, and CPI itself is not a generally significant product-demand predictor. Keep disabled until a product class or model specifically justifies it.

variables.research_reference: Macroeconomic activity indicator; not treated as a general consumer-product demand predictor.
variables.exclusion_reason: Industrial production is better suited to industrial/B2B demand than a generic DemandScope default.
